description: Returns a verse, range or chapter in its original language (Hebrew, Greek or Aramaic) with its English and a link; a range is capped at 80 verses. edition (septuagint, onkelos, pseudo-jonathan, jonathan, hebrew-nt, hebrew, greek) chooses the text. words=true adds, for each verse whose words line up with the Strong's tagging, every word's Strong's number, lemma, meaning and grammatical parsing. Use when the user asks to read or quote a verse, range or chapter.

edition.description: which text, e.g. septuagint, onkelos, pseudo-jonathan, jonathan, hebrew-nt, hebrew or greek

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

words.description: true adds each word's Strong's number, lemma, meaning and parsing

name: get_passage
title: Read a passage
